body.title: Argv, executor and failure mapper
body.summary: Create src/daemon/tools/builtins/jira/exec.ts with jiraArgv (head acli, free text as one --flag=value token, no --paginate), acliExec (runShellBytes, standard input closed, one 'acli jira auth status' probe after an unexplained failure) and jiraFailureOf (precedence and positive-evidence sign-in rule), plus the fake acli test harness _fakeacli.ts.
acceptanceChecks: jiraArgv starts with acli jira, replaces the gh head of buildArgv, passes --yes where acli has it, never --paginate and never --from-json or --generate-json
a free-text value that starts with '-' is passed as one --flag=value token

jiraFailureOf returns missing-tool for a spawn failure or exit 127, timed-out with 'outcome is unknown' for a changing op, and missing-signin only when the probe completed and said unauthorized; a probe that failed on network, time-out or spawn never gives missing-signin
a known rejection text is rejected without running the probe and an output cut at the capture cap is a failure

tests.name: jira-argv.test.ts: jiraArgv head, --yes, literal --json, finite --limit, never --paginate and free text as one --flag=value token
jira-failures.test.ts: jiraFailureOf precedence and the probe rules
jira-failures.test.ts: not installed, not signed in, network probe, time-out and truncated output through a fake acli
